verses.1: But the poor again lie down upon their beds, and if the rich do not support them, they become like a dry tree that has no moisture; and if it has no moisture, it does not put forth roots, and if it has no roots, it does not put forth branches.
verses.2: And if it does not put forth branches, it does not bear fruit, for the branch is prepared for the bearing of fruit; and he who has no fruit has no good works, for the fruit of a man himself is righteousness.
verses.3: And if he does righteousness, he produces uprightness, and God rejoices over the man who does righteousness and uprightness.
verses.4: And He gives his prayer to the one who prays and thirsts with his lips, and He does not reject the righteous man because of the righteousness which he has done.
verses.5: And as for him who justifies the sinner without repentance, because of the evil deeds which he has done—God is righteous and loves righteousness, and He does not show partiality to the person of a master, nor to the poor in judgment; for He is the Maker of heaven and earth, and the soul of every one is in His hand.
